headline: On last trading session, Sensex and Nifty snapped a 4-week rally to end lower led by IT sell-off.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 30 November.

why: IT stocks led a sharp sell-off, dragging benchmark indices down significantly.
Investors engaged in profit booking following a brief mid-week recovery.
Fluctuations in crude oil prices and global demand concerns weighed on market sentiment.
Bond markets stayed cautious ahead of the upcoming RBI monetary policy decision.
whatHappening: Sensex tumbled nearly 1,000 points while Nifty50 dropped below 25,650 on the last trading day.
Both Nifty50 and Sensex snapped their four-week winning streak to close the week in the red.
During the weekly performance wrap, TCS led the stock gains while Tata Steel lagged.
Tata Sons filed caveats after the Bombay High Court refused relief regarding Tata trusts' plea.
summary: On the last trading session, Indian stock markets ended lower as Sensex fell nearly 1,000 points and Nifty dropped below 25,650, ending a four-week winning streak. Heavy sell-offs in IT stocks and profit-booking pulled the benchmark indices down. Market participants also remained cautious ahead of the upcoming RBI policy decision.
